title: Synthesis of zapalog \(TMP-DANB-SLF)
protocol: Reconstitute B-2 (500 mg, 1.78 mmol) in 1.5 ml of acetic acid.
Slowly add the solution of B-2 to a mixture of 65% HNO3 (10 ml) and acetic anhydride (2 ml) at 0°C.
Stir the reaction mixture for 3 hours.
Pour the mixture into ice-cold water.
Collect the precipitate by filtration immediately after pouring.
Wash the collected precipitate extensively with water.
Dry the precipitate under vacuum to obtain B-3 as a pale yellow solid in 61% yield.
Repeat the reaction at a scale of 16 g of B-2 to produce B-3 (11 g).
Dissolve B-3 (350 mg, 1.08 mmol) in 26 ml of methanol at 0°C.
Slowly add NaBH4 (105 mg, 2.78 mmol) in portions to the solution.
Stir the reaction mixture for 3 hours.
Quench the reaction by adding 20 ml of NH4Cl (aq).
Extract the reaction mixture with ethyl acetate.
Wash the extract with brine.
Dry the organic layer over Na2SO4.
Remove the solvents under vacuum to obtain a crude product.
Purify the crude product by flash chromatography using petroleum ether:ethyl acetate = 2:1 ratio.
Obtain B-4 as a white solid in 79% yield from purification.
Repeat the reaction at a scale of 11 g of B-3 to produce B-4 (9.6 g).
To a solution of B-4 (100 mg, 0.305 mmol) and KI (51 mg, 0.305 mmol) in 2 ml DMF at 0°C add NaH (14 mg, 0.336 mmol).
Stir the mixture at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add allylbromide (46 mg, 0.367 mmol) to the mixture.
Heat the reaction at 70°C overnight.
Add water and EtOAc to the reaction mixture.
Separate the organic layer from the aqueous layer.
Wash the organic layer with water and brine.
Dry the organic layer by Na2SO4.
Concentrate the organic layer and purify by prep-TLC.
Repeat the reaction at 1 g scale of B-4 to give B-5 916 mg.
To a solution of B-5 (60 mg, 0.163 mm) and osmium tetraoxide (1 mg, 0.004 mmol) in 1 ml THF and 1 ml water add Sodium periodate (140 mg, 0.653 mmol).
Stir the reaction at 50°C for 2 hours.
Purify the mixture by prep-TLC.
Repeat the reaction at 910 mg scale of B-5 to give B-6 700 mg.
To a solution of B-6 (30 mg, 0.081 mmol) in MeOH (3 mL) add NaBH4 (3 mg, 0.081 mmol).
Stir the reaction at room temperature for 2 hours.
Purify the mixture by prep-TLC.
Repeat the reaction at 700 mg scale of B-6 to give B-7 370 mg.
Reconstitute B-7 with CBr4 and PPh3 in DCM at 0°C under Ar.
Stir the mixture at room temperature overnight.
Purify the reaction mixture by prep-TLC.
Repeat the reaction at a 700 mg scale to obtain compound B.
Mix A with K2CO3 in DMF and stir at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add B to the mixture of A and K2CO3, then stir at 40°C under Ar for 3 hours.
Purify the reaction mixture by prep-TLC.
Repeat the preparation of compound 5 at a larger scale to obtain 140 mg.
Reconstitute solution of 5 in 0.5 ml THF and 0.5 ml water.
Add LiOH.H2O to the reconstituted solution at 0°C under Ar.
Stir the reaction mixture at room temperature overnight.
Purify the mixture by prep-TLC to obtain compound 6.
Repeat the reaction at a 120 mg scale to yield more compound 6.
To a solution of compound 6 in 0.5 ml DMF, add DIEA and HATU at 0°C under Ar.
Stir the mixture for 10 minutes.
Add SLF-NH2 to the reaction solution.
Stir the reaction mixture at room temperature overnight.
Purify the mixture by prep-TLC to obtain crude product.
Further purify the crude product by HPLC to give purified product.
Repeat the reaction at a 40 mg scale and combine two batches of product.
Purify the combined product via prep-TLC twice to yield target compound.
